# Tool reference

Every tool the API offers, generated from the API specification (engine 1.0.42). Each tool is `POST /v1/tools/{name}`, and each client has a method of the same name.

| Tool | Domain | What it does | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`allocate_production`](network.md#allocate_production) | Network solving | Source-tagged production allocation (back-allocation): solve the network and attribute the mass on every edge back to the sources it came from. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`optimise_network`](network.md#optimise_network) | Network solving | Optimise a network: move control variables within bounds to maximise / minimise an objective (phase rate, revenue, pressure drop, power, deviation from measurements) under rate / pressure / temperature / velocity / power / pump / resource constraints. The optimisation counterpart of solve_network. | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |
| [`run_molecule_tracking`](network.md#run_molecule_tracking) | Network solving | Trace component compositions through an already-solved network. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`solve_network`](network.md#solve_network) | Network solving | Solve a complete production network (Newton-Raphson): pressures, temperatures and rates at every node and edge. The headline tool. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`solve_network_map`](network.md#solve_network_map) | Network solving | Data-reconciliation solve (MAP): reconcile pressure gauges and rate meters, each with a variance, against the network physics and estimate uncertain source inputs, returning posterior variances and a per-measurement misfit. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_nodal_analysis`](ipr.md#calculate_nodal_analysis) | Well inflow (IPR / nodal) | Operating point = IPR intersect VLP for one well and one tubing run. Generates both curves and finds the stabilised rate and flowing BHP. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`generate_ipr_curve`](ipr.md#generate_ipr_curve) | Well inflow (IPR / nodal) | Inflow performance relationship (IPR) curve for one well; real physics per point. Required inputs depend on ipr_model (19 models). | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`generate_type_curve`](ipr.md#generate_type_curve) | Well inflow (IPR / nodal) | Dimensionless transient type-curve surface (pD/qD, Bourdet derivative) for a transient ipr_model, with the dimensionless groups derived from the geometry. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`run_nodal_study`](ipr.md#run_nodal_study) | Well inflow (IPR / nodal) | Nodal analysis of one well inside a network: IPR sweep, VLP by full network solves, their operating point, and optional sensitivity overlays. | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |
| [`match_fetkovich_ab`](inflow.md#match_fetkovich_ab) | Inflow matching / transient | Fit A and B of the fetkovich_ab oil deliverability equation q = A·(pr − psat) + B·(psat² − pwf²) to test points. | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |
| [`match_forchheimer_ab`](inflow.md#match_forchheimer_ab) | Inflow matching / transient | Fit A and B of the forchheimer_ab gas deliverability equation pr² − pwf² = A·q + B·q² to test points. | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |
| [`match_parameters`](inflow.md#match_parameters) | Inflow matching / transient | Unified matching dispatcher: fit productivity_index / skin / forchheimer_ab / fetkovich_ab, routed by match_target or ipr_model. | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |
| [`match_productivity_index`](inflow.md#match_productivity_index) | Inflow matching / transient | Fit the pi model's productivity index to observed (oil rate, flowing-BHP) test points. | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |
| [`match_skin`](inflow.md#match_skin) | Inflow matching / transient | Fit the mechanical skin of a darcy or fetkovich model to observed (oil rate, flowing-BHP) test points. | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |
| [`rta_diagnostics`](inflow.md#rta_diagnostics) | Inflow matching / transient | Rate-transient-analysis diagnostics (Blasingame, Agarwal-Gardner, Bourdet) with material-balance time and pseudo-time, from a time/rate/pressure history. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`transient_bhp_history`](inflow.md#transient_bhp_history) | Inflow matching / transient | Compute the flowing-BHP history from a rate history (transient superposition). | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`transient_rate_history`](inflow.md#transient_rate_history) | Inflow matching / transient | Compute the rate history from a pressure history (transient superposition). | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_pressure_drop`](flow.md#calculate_pressure_drop) | Flow (pressure drop) | Multiphase pressure gradient at one point in a pipe using a chosen correlation. Returns gradient components, holdup, flow regime and hydraulics. | Costs 1 credit. |
| [`compare_pressure_drop_correlations`](flow.md#compare_pressure_drop_correlations) | Flow (pressure drop) | Run every multiphase pressure-drop correlation (or a subset) on one segment and compare the predicted gradients. | Costs 3 credits. |
| [`calculate_choke_pressure_drop`](choke.md#calculate_choke_pressure_drop) | Chokes | Pressure drop across a choke of known diameter at given rates (Sachdeva multiphase model, critical/subcritical). | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_choke_size`](choke.md#calculate_choke_size) | Chokes | Size a choke: find the bean diameter that gives a target downstream pressure at the supplied rates. | Costs 1 credit. |
| [`calculate_rate_from_choke`](choke.md#calculate_rate_from_choke) | Chokes | Find the rates a fixed choke passes for a given pressure drop, holding a phase or ratio (watercut/GOR/WGR/CGR) fixed. | Costs 1 credit. |
| [`calculate_pipe_traverse`](pipeline.md#calculate_pipe_traverse) | Pipelines | March pressure and temperature along a single straight pipe (one diameter, length and angle) with heat transfer. | Costs 3 credits. |
| [`compare_pipeline_correlations`](pipeline.md#compare_pipeline_correlations) | Pipelines | Walk a multi-segment pipe with each correlation and compare the predicted outlet pressure. | Costs 3 credits. |
| [`list_transient_solvers`](transient.md#list_transient_solvers) | Transient pipe flow | Which of the three transient schemes to use, what each carries, and the conventions every transient request shares. | Free. |
| [`run_transient_field`](transient.md#run_transient_field) | Transient pipe flow | Transient multiphase pipe flow, fully-implicit four-field two-fluid (Graphsolve-Field): for severe slugging and countercurrent flow. | Costs 250 credits, plus 1 per 50 ms beyond the first 30 s of compute. |
| [`run_transient_flux`](transient.md#run_transient_flux) | Transient pipe flow | Transient multiphase pipe flow, semi-implicit sequential (Graphsolve-Flux): the general-purpose scheme, carrying temperature, the oil/water split and salinity. | Costs 250 credits, plus 1 per 50 ms beyond the first 30 s of compute. |
| [`run_transient_wave`](transient.md#run_transient_wave) | Transient pipe flow | Transient multiphase pipe flow, explicit Godunov/Rusanov drift flux (Graphsolve-Wave): the only scheme that resolves pressure waves. | Costs 250 credits, plus 1 per 50 ms beyond the first 30 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_corrosion_rate`](flow_assurance.md#calculate_corrosion_rate) | Flow assurance | Internal CO2/H2S corrosion rate over three models (de Waard-Lotz, sour with the Mariaca regime factor, NORSOK M-506), with NACE MR0175 region, inhibited rate and wall allowance. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`calculate_wax_deposition_rate`](flow_assurance.md#calculate_wax_deposition_rate) | Flow assurance | Wax deposition rate on a cold wall from the subcooling and the wax solubility gradient — thickness in mm/yr and mass flux in g/m2/day. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`evaluate_flow_assurance_profile`](flow_assurance.md#evaluate_flow_assurance_profile) | Flow assurance | Hydrate, corrosion and erosion screening along a whole line, each reporting the controlling sample — index, length, pressure and temperature — not just a worst-case number. | Costs 8 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 4 s of compute. |
| [`list_flow_assurance_models`](flow_assurance.md#list_flow_assurance_models) | Flow assurance | The model vocabularies the flow-assurance tools accept — hydrate, wax, asphaltene, corrosion and scale models with their tier, plus how wax formers are identified, inhibitor names, vdWP guests, the scale risk bands, the NACE MR0175 regions and the API RP 14E service classes. | Free. |
| [`partition_acid_gas_in_water`](flow_assurance.md#partition_acid_gas_in_water) | Flow assurance | How much CO2 and H2S is dissolved in the produced water, and the in-situ pH that leaves — the brine pH the corrosion models should consume instead of a condensed-water estimate. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`screen_asphaltene_risk`](flow_assurance.md#screen_asphaltene_risk) | Flow assurance | De Boer (1995) asphaltene-onset screening from in-situ undersaturation and live-oil density; four-bin risk classification. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`screen_hydrate_risk`](flow_assurance.md#screen_hydrate_risk) | Flow assurance | Hydrate formation temperature and margin at a live state, over four models (Towler-Mokhatab screening or vdW-Platteeuw sI / sII / combined), with Hammerschmidt inhibitor depression. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`screen_liquid_loading`](flow_assurance.md#screen_liquid_loading) | Flow assurance | Turner critical-velocity screen for gas-well liquid loading: critical velocity, ratio and a loading flag. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`screen_scale_risk`](flow_assurance.md#screen_scale_risk) | Flow assurance | Mineral-scale saturation indices from a produced-water ion analysis — calcite, aragonite, siderite, barite, celestite, gypsum, anhydrite and halite — with the precipitable mass and the limiting ion. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`screen_wax_risk`](flow_assurance.md#screen_wax_risk) | Flow assurance | Wax appearance temperature and margin over three tiers: a C7+ screening correlation, the Won multi-solid SLE, or the non-ideal SLE flash with per-component solid fractions, measured melting data and the solubility gradient for the deposition rate. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`analyse_turbo_performance`](equipment.md#analyse_turbo_performance) | Equipment (rotating) | Back-calculate head, efficiencies and powers from measured suction and discharge states by path method, and fit a turbo_machine map to the points. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_compression_train`](equipment.md#calculate_compression_train) | Equipment (rotating) | Compression train on a composition: per stage a turbo machine, an intercooler on the EOS enthalpy and a scrubber that removes the condensed liquid; stage and train power, duty, liquid and compositions. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_compressor`](equipment.md#calculate_compressor) | Equipment (rotating) | Single-stage centrifugal compressor: outlet P/T and power from inlet P/T, pressure ratio, and polytropic efficiency. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_multistage_compressor`](equipment.md#calculate_multistage_compressor) | Equipment (rotating) | Multi-stage centrifugal train with optional inter-stage cooling; per-stage pressure ratios and overall discharge P/T, cooler duty and shaft power. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_pump`](equipment.md#calculate_pump) | Equipment (rotating) | Centrifugal pump or ESP at one suction state on the network pump model: discharge P/T, head, power, NPSH, per-section operating range and the ESP drive train. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_pump_head`](equipment.md#calculate_pump_head) | Equipment (rotating) | Single head-curve lookup: discharge pressure from one head-vs-rate curve read at one flow with one liquid density. No stages, speed, gas or power model; see calculate_pump. | Costs 1 credit. |
| [`calculate_reciprocating_compressor`](equipment.md#calculate_reciprocating_compressor) | Equipment (rotating) | Reciprocating (positive-displacement) compressor. Mass flow is set by displacement x speed x volumetric efficiency, not supplied. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_screw_compressor`](equipment.md#calculate_screw_compressor) | Equipment (rotating) | Screw (positive-displacement) compressor closed by black-box efficiencies; mass flow = volumetric efficiency x suction density x displacement per revolution x shaft speed in rev/s. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_turbine`](equipment.md#calculate_turbine) | Equipment (rotating) | Single-stage centrifugal turbine/expander: outlet P/T and power generated from inlet P/T and an expansion pressure ratio (0 < PR < 1). | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_turbo_machine`](equipment.md#calculate_turbo_machine) | Equipment (rotating) | Any network turbo machine (centrifugal simple/mapped/map/multistage, axial, screw, reciprocating) at one operating point, on a GERG gas or an EOS composition, with a chosen path method. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_heater_cooler`](thermal.md#calculate_heater_cooler) | Thermal equipment | Heater/cooler on the network edge's energy balance, in fixed_duty, fixed_outlet_temperature, approach_temperature or ua mode; returns outlet P/T and duty. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_isenthalpic_temperature`](thermal.md#calculate_isenthalpic_temperature) | Thermal equipment | Outlet temperature after a constant-enthalpy (Joule-Thomson) expansion to a lower pressure. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_jt_valve`](thermal.md#calculate_jt_valve) | Thermal equipment | Joule-Thomson throttle valve: outlet T after an isenthalpic pressure drop. | Costs 1 credit, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 0.25 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_fluid_properties`](fluid.md#calculate_fluid_properties) | Fluid properties | Black-oil PVT properties (Bo, Rs, viscosity, density, Z) of oil / gas / water at a given P/T using the selected correlations. | Costs 1 credit. |
| [`calculate_gas_dew_point`](water.md#calculate_gas_dew_point) | Water | Gas dew-point pressure from temperature, gas gravity, oil API and condensate-gas ratio (Ahmadi). | Costs 1 credit. |
| [`calculate_water_properties`](water.md#calculate_water_properties) | Water | Brine properties (density, viscosity, compressibility, heat capacity, enthalpy) with a salinity correction. | Costs 1 credit. |
| [`adjust_composition_to_gor`](eos.md#adjust_composition_to_gor) | Compositional / EOS | Tune the heavy/light split of a composition to match a target surface GOR (Sm³/Sm³). | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`adjust_composition_to_phase_ratio`](eos.md#adjust_composition_to_phase_ratio) | Compositional / EOS | Tune a composition to a target in-situ gas-oil volume ratio (m3/m3) at given P/T. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_critical_point`](eos.md#calculate_critical_point) | Compositional / EOS | True critical point of a mixture (Heidemann-Khalil) with a cubic EOS: critical temperature, pressure, molar volume and Z-factor. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_mpfm_allocation`](eos.md#calculate_mpfm_allocation) | Compositional / EOS | Multiphase-flow-meter allocation: convert one meter reading (in-situ) to standard-condition rates with an EOS. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_reid_vapour_pressure`](eos.md#calculate_reid_vapour_pressure) | Compositional / EOS | Reid vapour pressure (RVP) of a liquid composition at 100 degF. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_saturation_pressure`](eos.md#calculate_saturation_pressure) | Compositional / EOS | Bubble- or dew-point pressure of a composition at a temperature, or bubble- or dew-point temperature at a pressure (cubic EOS). | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`flash_to_surface`](eos.md#flash_to_surface) | Compositional / EOS | Flash a composition through a separator train to stock-tank: GOR, oil density, specific gravity and API gravity, gas gravity. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`generate_phase_envelope`](eos.md#generate_phase_envelope) | Compositional / EOS | Two-phase P-T envelope (dew/bubble locus + critical point) of a composition (Peng-Robinson or SRK). | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`run_eos_flash`](eos.md#run_eos_flash) | Compositional / EOS | EOS flash of a composition (Peng-Robinson default, SRK, or GERG-2008 for single-phase gas): PT, PH or PS; phase split, K-values, phase densities, and optionally each phase's viscosity, enthalpy, entropy and heat capacities. Pressure in MPa. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`run_process_graph`](eos.md#run_process_graph) | Compositional / EOS | Steady-state compositional flowsheet of Source, Separator, Mixer, Splitter and Sink nodes (no heaters or compressors), with recycle loops. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`tune_mpfm_allocation`](eos.md#tune_mpfm_allocation) | Compositional / EOS | Regress MPFM allocation parameters against measured observation rows (inverse of calculate_mpfm_allocation). | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |
| [`calculate_mmp`](pvt.md#calculate_mmp) | PVT (lab / regression) | Minimum miscibility pressure (MMP) between a reservoir fluid and an injection gas (mixing-cell method). | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`characterize_pseudo_component`](pvt.md#characterize_pseudo_component) | PVT (lab / regression) | Critical properties (Tc, Pc, Vc), acentric factor and Watson K of a pseudo-component from any two of MW / specific gravity / boiling point. | Costs 1 credit. |
| [`import_prp_fluid`](pvt.md#import_prp_fluid) | PVT (lab / regression) | Import a PVTsim .prp fluid file (text) as a composition for the PVT, process-graph and MPFM tools. | Costs 1 credit. |
| [`match_pvt`](pvt.md#match_pvt) | PVT (lab / regression) | Regress black-oil PVT correlations against measured lab data (bubble point, Rs, Bo, viscosity, density). | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |
| [`run_cce`](pvt.md#run_cce) | PVT (lab / regression) | Constant composition expansion (CCE) PVT experiment. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`run_cvd`](pvt.md#run_cvd) | PVT (lab / regression) | Constant volume depletion (CVD) PVT experiment (gas condensate / volatile oil). | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`run_dle`](pvt.md#run_dle) | PVT (lab / regression) | Differential liberation expansion (DLE) PVT experiment. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`run_gas_depletion`](pvt.md#run_gas_depletion) | PVT (lab / regression) | Gas-reservoir depletion study: p/z, Bg, recovery factor and retrograde liquid per pressure step. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`run_mmp_probe`](pvt.md#run_mmp_probe) | PVT (lab / regression) | Mixing-cell miscibility test at one pressure: forward and backward contact series and whether either reached miscibility. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`run_pvt_regression_suite`](pvt.md#run_pvt_regression_suite) | PVT (lab / regression) | Run several PVT experiments on one EOS fluid against lab data: per-field residuals and a weighted objective (evaluation, not tuning). | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`run_separator_test`](pvt.md#run_separator_test) | PVT (lab / regression) | Multi-stage separator test to stock-tank: stage GOR, FVF, stock-tank oil density. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`run_swelling_test`](pvt.md#run_swelling_test) | PVT (lab / regression) | Swelling test: add injection gas/solvent and report saturation pressure + swelling factor per step. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`split_plus_fraction`](pvt.md#split_plus_fraction) | PVT (lab / regression) | Split a heavy/plus fraction into N pseudo-components (gamma distribution). Front half of building a matched compositional fluid. | Costs 5 credits, plus 1 per 500 ms beyond the first 2 s of compute. |
| [`aggregate_type_well`](studies.md#aggregate_type_well) | Studies (asset management) | Aggregate analog wells into a probabilistic type well: P10/P50/P90 EUR, probability plot, representative declines, optional N-well program aggregate. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`analyze_material_balance`](studies.md#analyze_material_balance) | Studies (asset management) | Straight-line material-balance diagnostics: gas p/Z → OGIP, or Havlena-Odeh F-vs-Et → STOIIP/GIIP, with R² and drive-support intercept. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`calculate_aquifer_influx`](studies.md#calculate_aquifer_influx) | Studies (asset management) | Analytical aquifer water influx We over a pressure history: Fetkovich (PSS), Carter-Tracy or van Everdingen-Hurst (USS radial). | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`calculate_volumetrics`](studies.md#calculate_volumetrics) | Studies (asset management) | Forward OOIP / OGIP from area·thickness·NTG·φ·(1−Sw) ÷ FVF; scalar or per-realisation arrays, composes with generate_samples / compute_statistics for probabilistic in-place volumes. | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`compute_statistics`](studies.md#compute_statistics) | Studies (asset management) | Summary statistics (mean/std, percentiles, histogram, CDF) over labelled output columns, plus optional input→output correlation sensitivity; network-agnostic (e.g. NPV/EUR from an external model). | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`fit_decline`](studies.md#fit_decline) | Studies (asset management) | History-match a decline model (Arps / mod-hyperbolic / Duong / SEPD / PLE) to a time/rate history with optional outlier rejection; omit kind to auto-select by R². | Costs 2 credits. |
| [`generate_decline`](studies.md#generate_decline) | Studies (asset management) | Generate a decline curve (rate + cumulative) from known parameters: Arps, modified-hyperbolic, Duong, stretched-exponential (SEPD), power-law-exponential (PLE). | Costs 2 credits. |

| [`run_material_balance`](studies.md#run_material_balance) | Studies (asset management) | Tank material balance over one or more reservoir zones (STOIIP/GIIP, cumulative production, pressure decline, recovery factor); no aquifer. | Costs 25 credits, plus 1 per 250 ms beyond the first 5 s of compute. |
| [`run_parametric_study`](studies.md#run_parametric_study) | Studies (asset management) | Sensitivity / parametric study over a network (single-variable sweep, tornado, two-factor grid, Monte Carlo, envelope map); returns every run plus the study's summary. | Costs 100 credits, plus 1 per 100 ms beyond the first 10 s of compute. |

| [`calculate_hydrate_temperature`](engineering.md#calculate_hydrate_temperature) | Engineering checks | Hydrate formation temperature at a given pressure and gas gravity from the Towler-Mokhatab screening correlation; H2S and CO2 inputs are echoed, not applied. | Costs 1 credit. |
